slices.title: Decision provenance (event, audit, run log)
slices.summary: Records who decided and how (USER, POSTURE_AUTO, STANDING_GRANT, TIMEOUT, SYSTEM) in one transaction: metadata.decision, one content-free approval_decided audit outbox row, and an enriched state event. Retries are idempotent with a scope-conflict check, and the gateway ignores client-supplied sources. Audit emission is behind APPROVAL_AUDIT_EVENTS_ENABLED until audit-core accepts the wire fixture; the run-log envelope waits on WS13-D10.
test_commands: session-core tests: decision_provenance_is_recorded_in_metadata_and_outbox_in_one_transaction, a_replayed_decision_enqueues_one_audit_row, a_retry_with_a_different_scope_conflicts, an_unspecified_source_is_recorded_as_unattributed (run the DB-gated ones with --ignored --test-threads=1 and DATABASE_URL set)
the WS13-S1 cargo test, fmt, check and zdr-contract-sync commands, plus the N2 tag-diff

slices.title: Control run-action target table and view v2
slices.summary: Replaces the switch in runActionTarget with a user-core run_action_targets table (action_id, service_audience, permission, class, hash_basis, schema_hash) seeded with tickets.create only. The model-action view request takes optional action ids, intersected with the table and with agent entitlement (a read-class action needs no write entitlement), and the capability-core verifier accepts v2. Per K3-25 a row alone admits nothing: each new action also needs an OWNER_ACTION_PINS entry and an owner verifier.
